scientific_disclaimer: SAR dark formations represent areas of dampened capillary surface waves. Low backscatter can be caused by mineral oil spills, but also by natural environmental look-alikes such as biogenic films, low-wind calms, grease ice, or internal waves. Detected regions are candidate anomalies requiring multi-sensor or AIS drift verification.
